Our pharma R&D team has three lead compounds from Q3 screening (CPD-1001, CPD-1002, CPD-1003) that need to go through a formal, auditable selection process before we commit resources to Phase I trials. I've documented the full pipeline specification in `pharma_pipeline/reports/q4/q4_evaluation_plan.md` — please read that and execute everything it describes.

The pipeline must run entirely locally (no external servers). You'll need to set up the local decision framework from scratch, post the evaluation job with the exact parameters in the plan, submit all three agent evaluations, resolve the competition, and save the final outcome as `pipeline_result.json` in the workspace root.

The team needs this done end-to-end so the winning compound recommendation is captured in that result file.
